Animal Hospital of Unionville on Hwy7 in Markham, Ontario is a large established veterinary clinic since 1966. We love helping pets and their families. That's why we practice compassionate and advanced health care in a loving environment, giving you the options you need to help your pets live a long and happy life. .

Call us at 905-477-2323 or visit 
www.unionvet.ca
